identity.title: Cospatial Star Formation and Supermassive Black Hole Growth in z ∼ 3 Galaxies: Evidence for In Situ Co-evolution

paper_type_evidence.quote: This work demonstrates the unique complementarity of VLA and ALMA observations to unambiguously pinpoint the locations of AGN and star formation down to $\simeq30$ mas

question.value: Are the sites of SMBH growth (radio-dominated AGN) cospatial with the regions of intense dust-traced star formation in z~3 galaxies?

evidence.quote: We present a sub-kpc localization of the sites of supermassive black hole (SMBH) growth in three active galactic nuclei (AGN) at $z \sim 3$ in relation to the regions of intense star formation in their hosts.
we compiled pointed observations from programs ALMA# 2011.0.00097.S, 2013.1.00034.S, and 2015.1.00137.S

method.value: Extract VLA and ALMA sources at 5x rms with PyBDSM, cross-match to photo-z catalogs, build FIR/radio correlation vs redshift, select >=0.7 dex radio excess

evidence.quote: We extract VLA and ALMA sources down to $5\times$ the local rms noise using PyBDSM

key_parameters.value: 0.7 dex threshold (~3x correlation dispersion); 0.75'' match radius in COSMOS

evidence.quote: the 0.7-dex threshold being $\approx3$ times the dispersion of the far-infrared/radio correlation

method.value: 2D Gaussian fitting of VLA and ALMA emission, all parameters free; resolved if deconvolved size >0 in both axes

evidence.quote: measured with 2D Gaussian fitting using the AIPS task `JMFIT`; all Gaussian parameters were free.

key_parameters.value: positional errors add fit error and phase-calibrator accuracy (2 mas VLA HUDF, 10 mas VLA COSMOS, <=1 mas ALMA) in quadrature

evidence.quote: We add these two uncertainties in quadrature for all positional uncertainties considered.

evidence.quote: This results in 81 matches.

method.value: Fit Rieke09 IR templates at rest >40 um (ALMA, Herschel) to get L_IR; convert with Kennicutt98 (Chabrier IMF); check AGN contribution with Lyu & Rieke templates normalized to IRAC 5.8/8.0 um

evidence.quote: we use only observations at rest-frame wavelengths longward of 40 $\mu$m for the fit

assumptions.value: Maximal AGN scenario: all 5.8-8.0 um emission from AGN

evidence.quote: assumes that all of the $5.8 - 8.0$ $\mu$m emission is of AGN origin

claims.finding: AGN lie within compact star-forming regions, consistent with in-situ bulge and SMBH formation

evidence.quote: the sub/millimeter emission by dust tracing nearly pure star formation
